# Smart Capitalfor  India’s Early-Stage Startups

## Invested over   INR 150 Cr across  80+ start-ups

TCA is one of the leading Angel Investment Groups in India. TCA’s network consists of elite leaders that have successfully built, run and in many cases exited enterprises across multiple domains and industries.

TCA funds scalable startups that have gained market traction and are in the early revenue stage; provided they solve a critical problem for consumers or businesses, using a unique solution.

TCA’s investing members and portfolio investments are not limited by geography. Unusually for an angel investing group, TCA has a diversified portfolio that goes well beyond a restrictive tech focus, reflecting the diversity of its members’ interests. TCA portfolio companies benefit from the collective expertise and rolodex of its members.

Key areas of investment focus for TCA include Agritech & Sustainability, Electric Vehicles, Deep Science & Technology, Healthtech, Fintech, D2C and Web 3.0.

![](https://thechennaiangels.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/img-about-us.png)

## Inception

Aspiring entrepreneurs with innovative business ideas often fumble to translate thoughts into commercially viable ventures. These teething troubles could be attributed to inadequate awareness in taking ideas forward or paucity of funds. In an effort to help these young minds, a group of prominent successful entrepreneurs came forward to form a consortium called The Chennai Entrepreneurship Trust Fund in Nov 2007, which is now The Chennai Angels (TCA).

## Our Role Today

Besides providing capital, TCA members act as mentors for those venturing into the business world. TCA has among its members several Venture Capitalists who are available to partner TCA on larger outlays. Along with high quality mentoring, investors are able to handhold the entrepreneur through the life cycle of fundraising and open doors to customers and partners of very high order.

![](https://thechennaiangels.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/img-inception-our-rule-1.png)

![](https://thechennaiangels.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/TCA-group-photo.jpg)

### TCA Portfolio

## We’ve been a part of their growth journey.

## About   The Chennai Angels

Founded in 2007, The Chennai Angels (TCA) is one of India’s most active and trusted angel networks, bringing together 150+ seasoned investors with a shared passion for nurturing innovation. Over the years, we’ve invested over ₹193 Cr across 177+ deals, backing 99+ promising startups across diverse sectors. With ₹139+ Cr in successful exits, our track record reflects not just smart capital, but strategic mentorship and long-term partnership. At TCA, we don’t just invest in startups — we support and empower founders to build enduring businesses.

[Portfolio](https://thechennaiangels.com/portfolio/)

Connect founders with capital, mentorship, and strategic growth support.
